subject: cursor_plugins:skill:pstack/skills/tdd#test-skipped-when-impractical
why: Completes pending 2026-11-06-batch-p1:210: optional-regression-test-skip is written at .claude/skills/tdd/SKILL.md:48-53, in its ruled words (plan 59).
modification: Into `optional-regression-test-skip`. Upstream's rule governs cheap bug regressions in a skill with nothing else to prove. Ours also owns new risky behaviour and characterization, so the skip reaches only an optional regression test and never required proof.
rewording: An optional regression test for a bug may be skipped when it would cost more than the risk warrants: broad harness setup, brittle mocks, slow infrastructure, production-only state or unrelated fixture changes. Required acceptance proof and project gates stand, new test infrastructure is fine where that proof needs it, and proof that cannot be obtained is reported as blocked.
